instructions.mission: Implement story tasks for Epic {epic_num} Story {story_num}
instructions.critical: Execute continuously without pausing. Do NOT stop for milestones or progress updates.

steps.step: Load the story file and extract all tasks, acceptance criteria, and developer notes.
Load project context for coding standards, patterns, and conventions.
For each task in the story: 1. Write failing tests first (red) 2. Implement the minimum code to pass (green) 3. Refactor for quality (refactor) 4. Mark task checkbox complete
Run all tests and ensure: - All new tests pass - No existing tests broken - Code quality checks pass (linting, type checking)
- Verify all acceptance criteria met - Update story status to "review" - Update Dev Agent Record with model info and file list - Ensure all task checkboxes are checked
